Problem Description
: Outlet 2 out of order
Following our analysis of the logs from February 17th, we found that the outlet experienced three separate offline incidents. Below are the details of the causes for each occurrence:
Warning: NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED
– This issue was related to a temporary communication problem with the central server. It was caused by an SSL/TLS certificate verification warning. The charger automatically reconnected and resumed normal operation without any manual intervention.
Reboot via OCPP Backend
– The charger was  rebooted via the OCPP backend, which caused a brief disruption in service.
COAP Error
- T
his is a temporary issue, and the SiC D will automatically reconnect to the SECC within approximately 5 seconds.
General Error (Power Converter Failure in Fastdown)
– This issue was related to a power converter failure in the Fastdown system, which led to the outlet going offline.
Currently, the charging station is functioning well, but there is still an issue with the AC socket that needs further inspection.
W
e found the following error flags:
Please plan a site intervention to check the connections for the AC meter and also the wirings as per the below diagram:
Kindly check and confirm, if the FB1 is tripped.
Also carry one spare FB1 if needed please proceed with replacement.
P
roviding two MLFB options that may meet your needs:
5ST3010 -    FB1, -FB2, -FB3, -FC5, -FC18
5SV3344-4 -FB1 RCD Type B 3P+N 40A 30mA
Please review both before order.
